title: SurgNarrator: A Generative Retrieval Framework for Surgical Video Understanding
title_zh: SurgNarrator：用于手术视频理解的生成式检索框架
abstract_en: Surgical procedures unfold as structured and recurring clinical events, whose real-time understanding via intraoperative surgical videos is critical for intraoperative decision-making and support. However, existing video understanding methods force a trade-off: autoregressive video-language models support comprehensive reasoning but are not practical for time-sensitive clinical applications, whereas contrastive models offer low latency but struggle with complex scene understanding. Recently, generative retrieval has been explored for general-domain video understanding, but transferring it to surgery is not trivial because near-identical visual appearances may indicate semantically distinct events, and the terminology involved is highly surgery-specific. To this end, we propose SurgNarrator, a new generative retrieval framework tailored for surgical video understanding. We construct a well-curated surgery-centric vocabulary from surgical captions to define a clinically meaningful retrieval space. We then adapt the pre-trained Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B to learn discriminative clinical representations with a temporally-aware contrastive objective. During inference, a hierarchical, procedure-aware retrieval strategy narrows the search space to the relevant procedure type, delivering fast and effective responses. Our method is comprehensively evaluated on twelve benchmarks in a zero-shot setting and achieves consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines, while reducing output-stage latency by more than two orders of magnitude compared with the generative baseline.
abstract_zh: 该论文面向术中手术视频的实时理解问题，提出 SurgNarrator。现有方法通常在推理能力与低延迟之间权衡：自回归 video-language model 能进行复杂理解，但难以满足临床实时性；contrastive model 延迟低，却不擅长复杂场景语义。SurgNarrator 将生成式检索（generative retrieval）引入手术视频理解，并针对手术场景进行适配：首先从手术 caption 中构建 surgery-centric vocabulary，定义具有临床意义的检索空间；随后基于预训练 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B，通过 temporally-aware contrastive objective 学习更具判别性的临床表征；推理阶段采用 hierarchical, procedure-aware retrieval，先缩小到相关手术类型，再进行检索。实验在 12 个 benchmark 上以 zero-shot 设置评估，SurgNarrator 相比 state-of-the-art baseline 取得稳定提升，并相较生成式 baseline 将输出阶段延迟降低两个数量级以上。
key_points_zh: 提出 SurgNarrator，将 generative retrieval 用于 surgical video understanding，缓解自回归模型高延迟与对比模型语义理解不足的矛盾。
构建 surgery-centric vocabulary，使检索空间更贴合手术术语与临床事件语义，避免通用域词表难以表达手术细节的问题。
在 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B 基础上引入 temporally-aware contrastive objective，学习区分近似视觉外观但语义不同的手术事件。
推理时采用 hierarchical, procedure-aware retrieval，先按 procedure type 缩小搜索范围，从而提升检索效率与响应速度。
在 12 个 benchmark 的 zero-shot 评估中持续优于现有 SOTA baseline，并将输出阶段延迟较生成式 baseline 降低超过两个数量级。

llm_assessment.comment: A relevant low-latency surgical video understanding paper, though it is more retrieval/perception than a full realtime agent loop.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文与低延迟手术视频理解相关，但更偏检索感知而非完整实时智能体闭环。
